title: Apple: modeled ₹3,288/qtl left, Solan → Dharamshala
summary: February 2025: reported apple prices at Solan and Dharamshala imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 96% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹3,288 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 222 same-variety market pairs screened for apple in February 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Dharamshala report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2025
scenes.caption: Solan (Himachal Pradesh) and Dharamshala (Himachal Pradesh) both reported apple prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Solan reported a median ₹11,000 per quintal. Dharamshala reported a median ₹16,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹5,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹5,000 per quintal, and Dharamshala was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 269 km by road
scenes.caption: 269 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹3,553 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹2,733 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Dharamshala report, the rule selects 23 of 23 modeled shipping days. 22 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹3,288 per quintal (₹2,478 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Apple route from Solan to Dharamshala was positive on 96% of matched days in February 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹328,800, or ₹247,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to apple
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Apple route from Solan to Dharamshala was positive on 96% of matched days in February 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹328,800, or ₹247,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
